issues.on_page: Quality assurance assessment (note D) (98,888) under NONOPERATING REVENUES (EXPENSES)
issues.issue: This is a provider tax (an expense) printed among nonoperating items. Recording it as a negative receipt is defensible and the roll-forward holds, but it could also be a disbursement. Judgment call.
